name: UMI
summary: 通用移动操作接口与数据集，记录手持相机、末端动作和跨机器人操作轨迹。
summaryEn: A universal mobile-manipulation interface and dataset recording handheld vision, end-effector actions, and cross-robot trajectories.
scaleZh: 跨机器人移动操作演示
organizationsZh: 卡内基梅隆大学及合作团队
wmNote: 统一接口便于迁移动力学。
wmNoteEn: A unified interface aids dynamics transfer.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2402.10329] Universal Manipulation Interface: In-The-Wild Robot Teaching Without In-The-Wild Robots
evidence.statement: Handheld gripper demonstrations and relative-trajectory action representations support policy transfer; not directly measured robot torques.
